title: Creating & Game Design with Kahran & Divya
summary: Kahran and Divya debrief on their season-closer conversations with Katieann Vogel and Anurati Srivastva — the creative process, the loneliness vs. collaboration of making, and a deep tangent into games as a medium that teaches resilience (you die, you respawn) in ways that schooling can't. They preview next season's theme: interviewing pairs who collaborate on things together.
topics: Kahneman and Tversky as a creative pair
shielding vs opening up to collaborators

intents.display: to think about whether making is a solitary or collaborative act
to hear what games teach that classrooms can't
